D091 states 'net revenue has typically been higher in the second half... primarily due to seasonality in our wireless communications products... due to launches of new mobile devices'.

Both disclosures discuss factors that may overshadow typical seasonality, such as macroeconomic effects and product transition timing. D092 notes 'typical seasonality and industry cyclicality are overshadowed by other factors such as wider macroeconomic effects, the timing of customer deployments, significant product transitions'.
